title: 👓 Apple Cancels the Cheaper Vision Pro and Focuses on Smart Glasses!
body: 👓 Apple Cancels the Cheaper Vision Pro and Focuses on Smart Glasses!

A new report said that Apple has stopped developing the cheaper version of the Vision Pro headset, to focus its efforts on smart glasses that compete directly with Meta’s glasses. Apple’s glasses will follow a different timeline than usual, as a longer period than normal may pass between their announcement and their actual arrival in stores. Earlier reports had suggested that the glasses could be revealed at the 2027 developers’ conference.
Simply put: Apple is betting on lightweight glasses that look like ordinary glasses and work with camera and voice, instead of a huge, expensive virtual-reality headset.
Would you wear smart glasses if they became light and reasonably priced?
